lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਲਗੈ ਸਚਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh aap veechaareeai lagai sach piaar ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh reflects on the self, lovingly attached to the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kis no aakheeai aape devanahaar ||10||
lines.translation: O Nanak, whom can we ask? He Himself is the Great Giver. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਏਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਹੈ ਮਤ ਕੋ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: baabeehaa ehu jagat hai mat ko bharam bhulaai ||
lines.translation: This world is a rainbird; let no one be deluded by doubt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਬਾਬੀਂਹਾ ਪਸੂ ਹੈ ਇਸ ਨੋ ਬੂਝਣੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu baabee(n)haa pasoo hai is no boojhan naahi ||
lines.translation: This rainbird is an animal; it has no understanding at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਪੀਤੈ ਤਿਖ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit har kaa naam hai jit peetai tikh jaai ||
lines.translation: The Name of the Lord is Ambrosial Nectar; drinking it in, thirst is quenched.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨੑ ਪੀਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੀ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh jinh peeaa tinh bahuR na laagee aai ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those Gurmukhs who drink it in shall never again be afflicted by thirst. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰੁ ਸੀਤਲ ਰਾਗੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਐ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: malaar seetal raag hai har dhiaaiai saa(n)t hoi ||
lines.translation: Malaar is a calming and soothing raga; meditating on the Lord brings peace and tranquility.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਅਪਣੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾਂ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਲੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jeeu apanee kripaa kare taa(n) varatai sabh loi ||
lines.translation: When the Dear Lord grants His Grace, then the rain falls on all the people of the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵੁਠੈ ਜੀਆ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਧਰਣੀ ਨੋ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vuthai jeeaa jugat hoi dharanee no seegaar hoi ||
lines.translation: From this rain, all creatures find the ways and means to live, and the earth is embellished.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਲੁ ਹੈ ਜਲ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ihu jagat sabh jal hai jal hee te sabh koi ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, this world is all water; everything came from water.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸਦਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee ko viralaa boojhai so jan mukat sadaa hoi ||2||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, a rare few realize the Lord; such humble beings are liberated forever. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਇਕੋ ਤੂ ਧਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa veparavaahu iko too dhanee ||
lines.translation: O True and Independent Lord God, You alone are my Lord and Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਦੂਜੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਗਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: too sabh kichh aape aap dooje kis ganee ||
lines.translation: You Yourself are everything; who else is of any account?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਸ ਕੂੜਾ ਗਰਬੁ ਸਚੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਮਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: maanas kooRaa garab sachee tudh manee ||
lines.translation: False is the pride of man. True is Your glorious greatness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਰਚਾਇ ਉਪਾਈ ਮੇਦਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavaa gaun rachaai upaaee medanee ||
lines.translation: Coming and going in reincarnation, the beings and species of the world came into being.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਗਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur seve aapanaa aaiaa tis ganee ||
lines.translation: But if the mortal serves his True Guru, his coming into the world is judged to be worthwhile.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ਤ ਕੇਹੀ ਗਣਤ ਗਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: je haumai vichahu jaai ta kehee ganat ganee ||
lines.translation: And if he eradicates eogtism from within himself, then how can he be judged?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੋਹਿ ਗੁਬਾਰਿ ਜਿਉ ਭੁਲਾ ਮੰਝਿ ਵਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh mohi gubaar jiu bhulaa ma(n)jh vanee ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukh is lost in the darkness of emotional attachment, like the man lost in the wilderness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਟੇ ਪਾਪ ਅਸੰਖ ਨਾਵੈ ਇਕ ਕਣੀ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: kate paap asa(n)kh naavai ik kanee ||11||
lines.translation: Countless sins are erased, by even a tiny particle of the Lord's Name. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਖਸਮੈ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: baabeehaa khasamai kaa mahal na jaanahee mahal dekh aradaas paai ||
lines.translation: O rainbird, you do not know the Mansion of your Lord and Master's Presence. Offer your prayers to see this Mansion.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapanai bhaanai bahutaa bolahi boliaa thaai na paai ||
lines.translation: You speak as you please, but your speech is not accepted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਸਮੁ ਵਡਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਇਛੇ ਸੋ ਫਲ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: khasam vadaa daataar hai jo ichhe so phal paai ||
lines.translation: Your Lord and Master is the Great Giver; whatever you desire, you shall receive from Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਕਿਆ ਬਪੁੜਾ ਜਗਤੈ ਕੀ ਤਿਖ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: baabeehaa kiaa bapuRaa jagatai kee tikh jaai ||1||
lines.translation: Not only the thirst of the poor rainbird, but the thirst of the whole world is quenched. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਭਿੰਨੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: baabeehaa bhi(n)nee rain boliaa sahaje sach subhaai ||
lines.translation: The night is wet with dew; the rainbird sings the True Name with intuitive ease.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜਲੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਜੀਉ ਹੈ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu jal meraa jeeu hai jal bin rahan na jaai ||
lines.translation: This water is my very soul; without water, I cannot survive.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gurasabadee jal paaeeai vichahu aap gavaai ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, this water is obtained, and egotism is eradicated from within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਚਸਾ ਨ ਜੀਵਦੀ ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jis bin chasaa na jeevadee so satigur deeaa milaai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, I cannot live without Him, even for a moment; the True Guru has led me to meet Him. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੰਡ ਪਤਾਲ ਅਸੰਖ ਮੈ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kha(n)d pataal asa(n)kh mai ganat na hoee ||
lines.translation: There are countless worlds and nether regions; I cannot calculate their number.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਿਰਜੀ ਤੁਧੈ ਗੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: too karataa govi(n)d tudh sirajee tudhai goee ||
lines.translation: You are the Creator, the Lord of the Universe; You create it, and You destroy it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਮੇਦਨੀ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh medanee tujh hee te hoee ||
lines.translation: The 8.4 million species of beings issued forth from You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਖਾਨ ਮਲੂਕ ਕਹਹਿ ਕਹਾਵਹਿ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik raaje khaan malook kahahi kahaavahi koee ||
lines.translation: Some are called kings, emperors and nobles.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਸਾਹ ਸਦਾਵਹਿ ਸੰਚਿ ਧਨੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik saah sadaavahi sa(n)ch dhan doojai pat khoee ||
lines.translation: Some claim to be bankers and accumulate wealth, but in duality they lose their honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਦਾਤੇ ਇਕ ਮੰਗਤੇ ਸਭਨਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik daate ik ma(n)gate sabhanaa sir soee ||
lines.translation: Some are givers, and some are beggars; God is above the heads of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਾਜਾਰੀਆ ਭੀਹਾਵਲਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: vin naavai baajaareeaa bheehaaval hoee ||
lines.translation: Without the Name, they are vulgar, dreadful and wretched.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜ ਨਿਖੁਟੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਚੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: kooR nikhute naanakaa sach kare s hoee ||12||
lines.translation: Falsehood shall not last, O Nanak; whatever the True Lord does, comes to pass. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਉਗਣਵੰਤੀ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: baabeehaa gunava(n)tee mahal paaiaa auganava(n)tee door ||
lines.translation: O rainbird, the virtuous soul-bride attains the Mansion of her Lord's Presence; the unworthy, unvirtuous one is far away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar terai har vasai guramukh sadaa hajoor ||
lines.translation: Deep within your inner being, the Lord abides. The Gurmukh beholds Him ever-present.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂਕ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: kook pukaar na hovaee nadaree nadar nihaal ||
lines.translation: When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, the mortal no longer weeps and wails.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ ਘਾਲ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam rate sahaje mile sabad guroo kai ghaal ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Naam intuitively merge with the Lord; they practice the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||
